$comment: Base-controlled mapping of GitHub logins to the lanes they may write. Consumed by .github/workflows/ownership-authorization.yml (pull_request_target, base-only) together with the lane/<id>-* branch prefix; both must agree, otherwise authorization fails closed. Policy-controlled (R1); the orchestrator maintains it on behalf of the owner. Rescue lanes 2026-08-15/16 are driven by the orchestrator on the owner's behalf under the fork account.
